newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firms buy 40,000 T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firms buy 40,000 T U.S. wheat.

text.p: Philippine flour millers bought 40,000 tonnes U.S. wheat for July arrival, Manila grains traders said on Friday.
Traders said the firms, including Purefoods Corp, bought a total of 19,000 tonnes western white wheat at $156 to $157 per tonne FOB.

The firms also bought 12,000 dark northern spring wheat with 13.5 percent protein content at $179 to $180 per tonne FOB and 9,000 tonnes dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content at $181 to $182 per tonne FOB.
Traders also said other Philippine millers rejected bids for the supply of another 35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat due to high prices.
Three other millers are also planning to buy a total of 40,000 tonnes U.S. wheat on price dips, traders said.
"If the price of western white breaks $150 per tonne and dark northern spring wheat falls to $180 per tonne, I will buy," an executive in one of the flour mills told Reuters.
